n_series: BOM, Molicel P45B 12S1P pack; Master Log D-016
cell_dcir_ohm: Molicel datasheet typical DC, 50% SOC (secondary retailer copy)
cell_i_cont_A: BOM note; Molicel datasheet (80 C cell cutoff)
cell_i_chg_max_A: Molicel datasheet maximum charge (70 C cutoff)
discharge_temp_C: Molicel datasheet (one retailer lists 80 C upper)
ocv_model: pchip NMC/NCA normalised shape, 2.50 V to 4.20 V
battery_ocv.m (Electrical AK80 model v2.2); ASSUMED sizing curve, not a measured OCV
dcir_temp_coeff_per_C: ASSUMED, 1% DCIR rise per degree below 25 C, clamped to 0.6x..2.5x
pack_extra_r_ohm: exo_model_config.m battery.pack_extra_resistance_Ohm: busbar, BMS FET, harness (ASSUMED)
cell_rp_ohm: ASSUMED placeholder, same role as Rp_Ohm in battery_gait_ode_rhs.m
cell_cp_F: ASSUMED placeholder, same role as Cp_F in battery_gait_ode_rhs.m
pack_cth_J_per_K: ASSUMED, 12 x 0.069 kg x 1255 J/kgK (Li-ion cell specific heat, literature class value)
pack_rth_K_per_W: ASSUMED still-air belt enclosure; no thermal test on record
uvp_trip_V: PROPOSED, margin above the 2.5 V cutoff
uvp_delay_s: PROPOSED, so load sag does not trip UVP before the short-circuit path
sc_trip_A: PROPOSED, below the 150 A BMS continuous rating
otp_trip_C: PROPOSED, 5 C below the 60 C datasheet limit
derate_warn_frac: PROPOSED, no Controls agreement on record (I-08)
derate_stop_frac: PROPOSED, CTRL-005 software stop commands zero torque
derate_tau_s: PROPOSED first-order torque ramp, avoids a step change in assistance
derate_recover_s: PROPOSED hold time of fresh data before leaving a derate state
regen_enabled_default: exo_model_config.m assist.regen_enabled = false, no regen credit until bench data exist
regen_v_headroom_V: PROPOSED, hold the highest cell this far below the OVP trip while charging
regen_temp_lo_C: Molicel charge temperature minimum, charge inhibited below this
regen_temp_taper_lo_C: PROPOSED taper band, 0 A at 0 C rising to full acceptance at 5 C
regen_temp_taper_hi_C: PROPOSED, taper to zero between here and the 55 C OTP trip
regen_soc_full: PROPOSED, accept no charge above this SOC
clamp_present: PD-14 OPEN, regeneration clamp (90 USD, 12 to 58 V, 80 A continuous) neither selected nor rejected
clamp_threshold_V: PROPOSED turn-on, above the 50.4 V full-charge pack and below the 52 V driver maximum
clamp_r_ohm: ASSUMED dissipation resistor, no part selected (PD-14)
bus_capacitance_uF: ASSUMED motor-bus bulk capacitance, no capacitor on the BOM
precharge_r_ohm: PROPOSED precharge resistor, not on the BOM (RK-03 lists precharge as Not chosen)
actuator_peak_A_each: Technical Baseline 6.1, AK80-9 peak phase current
actuator_count: Technical Baseline, powered hip and knee, Phase 1 unilateral
surge_dual_peak_A: BOM worst case 2 x 28 A, exceeds the 45 A cell rating by 11 A (RK-01)
surge_rise_s: ASSUMED current-loop rise time of the AK60 driver
ctl_data_hemi: Electrical > Test Data; OpenSim Moco post-stroke gait prediction, model 40p 11d24m
ctl_data_healthy: Electrical > Test Data; OpenSim inverse dynamics, 6 Hz kinematic low pass
ctl_assist: fraction of the weak-to-strong torque gap
one_sided_battery_current.m assist (1 = weak leg fully matches the strong leg)
ctl_weak_side: one_sided_battery_current.m weakSide, auto picks the lower RMS-moment side
ctl_bus_V_fixed: one_sided_battery_current.m V, the fixed bus voltage v1.5 replaces
ctl_include_aux_load: v1.5 addition: the MATLAB model carries no auxiliary load; the pack does
gear_eff_motoring: exo_model_config.m (ASSUMED loss model, no bench data)
dt_s: Chosen so the 10 ms short-circuit delay is resolved

inrush_with_precharge.note: The surge is far shorter than the 10 ms short-circuit delay, so the BMS does not act on it. Rate the contactor, connectors and FETs for the peak, or fit the precharge resistor.

inrush_without_precharge.note: The surge is far shorter than the 10 ms short-circuit delay, so the BMS does not act on it. Rate the contactor, connectors and FETs for the peak, or fit the precharge resistor.

assist_ceiling_study.note: A point marked not tripped is limited by the actuator and by the thermal rating, not by the pack. Compare knee_rms_phase_A against the 12 A rated phase current before reading an assist level as available.

bus_voltage_study.note: The coupled column includes the auxiliary load, which the MATLAB model does not carry. Both effects push battery current up.
